thread:
Eli (Acme): Hey team — our trial credits for org acme-integrations expired mid-handoff and our integration tests started getting 403s. Can someone look? We expected trial to be valid through 2025-03-02.

Oliver (CSM): Sorry to hear that. Can you drop the org_id and a sample request_id or timestamp so we can pull logs?

Eli (Acme): org_id: org_0A1b2C3D
Example error from logs:
```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
x-request-id: req_63b2f1a9
Response: 403 Forbidden
{ "error": "insufficient_credits", "message": "trial credits exhausted" }
```
This happened at 2025-03-01T22:16:02Z during a scripted load.

Aisha (Support): Thanks — checking the account now. Did you apply any promo or change billing contacts around that time?

Eli (Acme): No promo applied. Billing contact is eli@acme.co. We did migrate projects into a new master org around 2025-03-01T21:30Z as part of the handoff. Maybe metadata got dropped.

Aisha (Support): Got it. There's a known migration sync window where trial metadata can be detached. Pulling audit logs.

billing-bot: Ticket created BILL-834: "Org org_0A1b2C3D trial credit discrepancy during org migration" assigned to @Ravi (Billing).

Ravi (Billing): Looking at the grant table — during the migration a retry path reattached the trial grant row with grants.trial_expires = NULL. The billing service treats NULL as expired. We'll need a manual restore of the original expiry.

Priya (Eng): Infra note: migration job v2 had a bug that wrote NULL for expiry on reattach when a race occurred. Patch ready to treat NULL as preserve-existing-expiry; rolling to prod.

Aisha (Support): Next steps: Ravi to propose reinstatement window and optional goodwill tokens. Eli, what would get you back to green?

Eli (Acme): If you can restore the trial through 2025-03-06 and add ~50k tokens to cover test runs, that's ideal.

Ravi (Billing): Approve provisional manual reinstatement. I'll set trial_expires = 2025-03-06T23:59:59Z and post a one-time 50,000 token credit. This will be a manual ledger entry (non-recurring).

Ravi (Billing): Applied -> ledger_tx: TXN-BILL-1792. Visible: trial_tokens_remaining ~51234, expiry 2025-03-06T23:59:59Z.

billing-bot: Billing update: TXN-BILL-1792 posted to org_0A1b2C3D.

Eli (Acme): Confirmed — API calls are succeeding again. Resume testing at 2025-03-01T22:24:10Z. Tokens are decrementing from the credit pool.

Priya (Eng): Deployed fix to migration job to avoid NULL expiry writes. Monitoring for similar issues in other regions.

Oliver (CSM): I'll send Eli a recap email with the credit tx and the engineering fix. Action items: Ravi to close BILL-834 after 48h confirmation; Priya to keep an eye on rollout; Aisha to close the support case after customer ok.

Ravi (Billing): Leaving BILL-834 open 48h pending confirmation, then close.

Eli (Acme): All good from our side, thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
